component.name: Jackdaw
component.summary: Lightweight HTML editor with live preview

description.p: Jackdaw is a lightweight, open-source HTML editor with a live split preview pane. It features syntax highlighting with color swatches, HTML tag validation, spell check, a snippet system with mirrored tabstops, and dark/light themes.

ul.li: Live split preview with scroll and click sync
HTML syntax highlighting with inline color swatches
HTML tag validation with clickable error panel and gutter markers
Spell check with personal dictionary (right-click suggestions)
Snippet system with tabstop expansion and mirrored stops
Firefox-style Find and Find & Replace bar
Multi-tab editing with session restore and crash recovery
Rich copy — paste into Google Docs with syntax colors
Tab/Shift+Tab indentation with VS Code-style indent guides
Tag completion: Manual, Smart, and Auto modes
